name: Stele
author: Erin Carter
description: A memorial field of flat-topped slabs on a strict grid, raymarched from a high eye tilted steeply down: rank on rank of dim lit rectangles converge into haze while the camera glides diagonally across the field, dark mist pooling in the alleys and rare slabs carrying a glowing inscribed seam.

params.label: Glide speed
params.effect: How fast the camera crosses the slab field.

params.label: Slab spacing
params.effect: Width of the lanes between slabs - narrow makes a dense necropolis, wide an open field.

params.label: Height variance
params.effect: Spread of slab heights - low is a uniform terrace, high mixes stumps with towers.

params.label: Seam glow
params.effect: Brightness of the rare glowing seams inscribed on chosen slabs.
